jobs_held.name: jobs_held
jobs_held.value: not "jobs"."running" or ("jobs"."holder" is not null and "jobs"."heartbeat_at" is not null)

model_limits_per_minute.name: model_limits_per_minute
model_limits_per_minute.value: ("model_limits"."per_minute" is null) = ("model_limits"."per_minute_learned_at" is null) and ("model_limits"."per_minute" is null or "model_limits"."per_minute" > 0)

model_limits_per_day.name: model_limits_per_day
model_limits_per_day.value: ("model_limits"."per_day" is null) = ("model_limits"."per_day_learned_at" is null) and ("model_limits"."per_day" is null or "model_limits"."per_day" > 0)

proposals_body_run_key.name: proposals_body_run_key
proposals_body_run_key.value: "proposals"."fingerprint" is not distinct from ("proposals"."body" ->> 'fingerprint') and "proposals"."read_id" is not distinct from ("proposals"."body" ->> 'readId')

rule_decisions_definition.name: rule_decisions_definition
rule_decisions_definition.value: ("rule_decisions"."kind" in ('accept', 'deny', 'choose', 'applies_to')) = ("rule_decisions"."definition_id" is not null and "rule_decisions"."definition" is not null and "rule_decisions"."rulebook_revision" is not null)

rule_decisions_applies_to.name: rule_decisions_applies_to
rule_decisions_applies_to.value: ("rule_decisions"."kind" = 'applies_to') = ("rule_decisions"."applies_to" is not null) and ("rule_decisions"."applies_to" is null or "rule_decisions"."applies_to" in ('every', 'some'))
